<section class="journey-scene" aria-labelledby="jornada-r">
<h2 id="jornada-r">R</h2>
<h3>A reta saiu!</h3>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Simular retornos excedentes, em pontos percentuais, para ilustrar o ajuste.
set.seed(26)
mercado <- -4:4
ativo <- round(0.35 + 0.85 * mercado + rnorm(length(mercado), sd = 0.9), 1)
dados <- data.frame(mercado, ativo)
modelo <- lm(ativo ~ mercado, data = dados)

# Converter os dados e os extremos da reta em posições no gráfico SVG.
x_svg <- function(x) 221 + 35 * x
y_svg <- function(y) 100 - 13 * y
limites <- range(mercado)
reta <- predict(modelo, newdata = data.frame(mercado = limites))
marcas_x <- c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4)
marcas_y <- c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4)

grafico <- c(
  '<svg class="journey-plot" viewBox="0 0 440 225" role="img" aria-label="Retornos simulados do ativo e do mercado, com reta de mínimos quadrados ascendente.">',
  sprintf('<line class="grid" x1="56" y1="%1$.0f" x2="400" y2="%1$.0f"/>', y_svg(marcas_y)),
  '<path class="axis" fill="none" d="M56 18 V171 H400"/>',
  sprintf('<text x="%d" y="189" text-anchor="middle">%d</text>', x_svg(marcas_x), marcas_x),
  sprintf('<text x="46" y="%d" text-anchor="end">%d</text>', y_svg(marcas_y) + 4, marcas_y),
  '<text x="220" y="210" text-anchor="middle">Retorno excedente do mercado (p.p.)</text>',
  '<text x="17" y="95" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 17 95)">Retorno excedente do ativo (p.p.)</text>',
  sprintf('<circle cx="%.0f" cy="%.1f" r="4" style="--delay: %.2fs"/>',
          x_svg(mercado), y_svg(ativo), seq_along(mercado) * 0.05),
  sprintf('<line class="fit" pathLength="1" x1="%.0f" y1="%.2f" x2="%.0f" y2="%.2f"/>',
          x_svg(limites[1]), y_svg(reta[1]), x_svg(limites[2]), y_svg(reta[2])),
  '</svg>'
)
cat(grafico, sep = "\n")
```

<button type="button" class="btn btn-success" data-control="play">Iniciar animação</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-success" data-control="previous" disabled>Anterior</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-success" data-control="next" disabled>Próxima</button>
<span class="journey-progress" role="status" aria-atomic="true"></span>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const journey = document.querySelector("#retrospectiva");
  const scenes = [...journey.querySelectorAll(".journey-scene")];
  const controls = journey.querySelector(".journey-controls");
  const play = controls.querySelector('[data-control="play"]');
  const previous = controls.querySelector('[data-control="previous"]');
  const next = controls.querySelector('[data-control="next"]');
  const progress = controls.querySelector(".journey-progress");
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  const sceneDuration = 5000;
  const lastScene = scenes.length - 1;

  let current = 0;
  let started = false;
  let playing = false;
  let animateScene = false;
  let timer;
  let deadline;
  let remaining = sceneDuration;

  function update() {
    scenes.forEach((scene, index) => scene.classList.toggle("is-current", index === current));
    journey.classList.toggle("is-playing", animateScene);
    journey.classList.toggle("is-paused", started && !playing && current !== lastScene);
    play.textContent = !started ? "Iniciar animação"
      : current === lastScene ? "Rever animação"
      : playing ? "Pausar" : "Continuar";
    previous.disabled = !started || current === 0;
    next.disabled = !started || current === lastScene;
    const announcement = started
      ? `${scenes[current].querySelector("h2").textContent} · ${current + 1} de ${scenes.length}`
      : `${scenes.length} cenas`;
    if (progress.textContent !== announcement) progress.textContent = announcement;
  }

  function schedule() {
    deadline = performance.now() + remaining;
    timer = window.setTimeout(() => show(current + 1), remaining);
  }

  function show(index) {
    window.clearTimeout(timer);
    current = index;
    animateScene = playing;
    remaining = sceneDuration;
    const focusedControl = document.activeElement;
    if (current === lastScene) playing = false;
    update();
    if ((focusedControl === previous && previous.disabled)
      || (focusedControl === next && next.disabled)) play.focus();
    if (playing) schedule();
  }

  function configureMotion() {
    window.clearTimeout(timer);
    started = false;
    playing = false;
    animateScene = false;
    current = 0;
    journey.classList.toggle("is-interactive", !reducedMotion.matches);
    controls.hidden = reducedMotion.matches;
    update();
  }

  play.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!started || current === lastScene) {
      started = true;
      playing = true;
      show(0);
    } else if (playing) {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      remaining = Math.max(0, deadline - performance.now());
      playing = false;
      update();
    } else {
      playing = true;
      update();
      schedule();
    }
  });
  previous.addEventListener("click", () => show(current - 1));
  next.addEventListener("click", () => show(current + 1));
  reducedMotion.addEventListener("change", configureMotion);
  configureMotion();
})();
</script>
